summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all major requirements. Unit tests isolate logic well (semver, commits, changelog, version-file, bump); integration tests verify end-to-end behavior. Fixture-based testing strategy is strong. Good edge-case coverage (empty logs, breaking-change markers, missing files, invalid versions, changelog merging). GitHub Actions workflow tested both structurally (YAML parsing, actionlint) and end-to-end via act with exact output validation. Gaps: CLI argument parsing in bump-version.ts lacks direct unit tests (tested only indirectly through integration tests); appendGithubOutput function not directly tested; some file-handling edge cases (corrupted JSON structures, symlinks, unicode) undertested; no concurrency/performance testing. Overall trustworthy for catching most regressions, with minor coverage gaps in CLI layer and specialized edge cases.
